title: 台账燃尽批次 8/8 · any 擦除簇 4 符号 —— 上游阻塞已解除,实测四条全部不可燃尽(objectstack#4115)
body:
> **⚠️ CORRECTED 2026-08-30 by the `domain:ui` seat (#5560). The original body is kept
> verbatim below the line — it is the evidence, not a draft.**
>
> **This card was NOT blocked when you read it.** The body opened with
> 「当前被上游阻塞,勿提前动工」 and the title said 「上游解除后处理」. Both became false on
> **2026-07-30**, when objectstack#4171 closed completed. Triage flagged the staleness on
> 2026-08-18, noting it had already repelled claimants for 19 days; by the time the card was
> actually dispatched that was **40 days**. A "do not start" line that outlives its own
> premise is not a neutral leftover — it is an active instruction to the next reader, and it
> was obeyed.
>
> **The card's stated start signal did not fire, and could not have.** The body says to watch
> the `_spec*IsStillAny` tripwires in `spec-derived-unions.test.ts` and treat their going red
> as the go-ahead. Those tripwires **no longer exist under that name** — objectui#3177
> replaced them after establishing that `any` was never the only blocker — and their
> replacements are green. Anyone following the documented rhythm would have waited forever.
>
> **Outcome: zero re-exports.** All four symbols were re-measured in the BUILT dist at
> `@objectstack/spec` 17.2.0 (source state and upstream issue state are both insufficient —
> dist erasure is invisible from either, which is the reason this ledger exists at all). None
> is burnable, and three of them for reasons that have nothing to do with the blocker this
> card recorded:
>
> | Symbol | Verdict | Why |
> |---|---|---|
> | `JoinNode` | not burnable | The spec no longer exports it **at all** — `TS2305` from both `/ui` and `/data` against a resolving control. Spec 17.0.0 retired the `query.joins` cluster. Nothing upstream to bind to. |
> | `NavigationItem` | not burnable | Upstream **is** precise now, so objectstack#4171 genuinely landed. The three semantic blockers objectui#3177 pinned are untouched by it. |
> | `NavigationItemSchema` | not burnable | Upstream is precise now too — **which is what makes this the dangerous one.** The live blocker is RUNTIME shape, invisible to every type-level probe: binding the spec's schema would make the published `objectui validate` reject navigation metadata this renderer accepts today. |
> | `JoinedReportBlock` | not burnable | **Still** erased, to `unknown`, by a cause objectstack#4171 never covered — a bare `z.ZodTypeAny`, not recursion. |
>
> **The standing lesson, for the next ledger card.** A closed upstream issue is not a licence
> to re-export. This batch's ledger entry named one blocker; measurement found three
> different live ones and zero instances of the recorded one. The reason a symbol is not
> derivable has to be re-measured at burn-down time, in the dist, per symbol — the ledger
> records *that there is* a reason, never *what* it still is.
>
> **Remaining debt is no longer carried as a card pointing at an upstream issue.** It is
> carried as pins that each name their own release condition, and the guard's
> machine-readable ledger goes from `3 untriaged collisions in 1 packages` to `0 untriaged
> collisions in 0 packages`, with the three symbols recorded in `ALLOW` as declared dialects
> carrying their measured reasons. Delivered by PR #6883.

---

objectstack#4115 债务台账的最后一批,**当前被上游阻塞,勿提前动工**。

## 本批符号(`@object-ui/types`,4 条)

`JoinNode`, `NavigationItem`, `NavigationItemSchema`, `JoinedReportBlock`

## 阻塞原因

spec 侧这些导出的类型在 dist 里被擦除,本地精确类型一旦 re-export 就会被替换掉——是穿着燃尽外衣的类型安全回退。两种擦除形态:

- **擦除为 `any`**(`JoinNode` / `NavigationItem` / `NavigationItemSchema`):递归 zod schema 标注 `z.ZodType` 所致(objectstack#4171)。`NavigationItemSchema` 本地也是递归 `z.ZodType`,同一机制。
- **擦除为 `unknown`**(`JoinedReportBlock`,批次 1 分诊时发现并移入):spec 把 `JoinedReportBlockSchema` 声明为 `z.ZodTypeAny`,其导出类型是 `unknown`。**这是守卫文件头原本没写的第四种分诊谎言**——头部的 `0 extends (1 & T)` 探针对 `unknown` 返回 `false`,只按头部行事的分诊会得出"可安全派生"的结论,然后删掉一整个 interface 的类型信息。批次 1(objectui#3167)已在守卫文件头补了 case 2b 并加了反向 pin。

## 解除条件与动工步骤

1. `spec-derived-unions.test.ts` 里的反向 pin:spec 把这些类型修好的那天它会**报红**——那就是本批的开工信号(或 objectstack#4171 关闭)。
2. 动工时:`NavigationItem` 优先整体 re-export;若伞形类型仍不可用但变体类型完整(`ObjectNavItem`/`ActionNavItem`/`GroupNavItem`…),按 objectui#3088 的做法从变体派生,不整份手抄。
3. `NavigationItemSchema` 若 spec 侧提供了可引用的 shape,参照 `ListViewSchema` 范式按引用流入。
4. 完成定义同批次 1。**台账清空后,在 objectstack#4115 评论总结并关闭它。**

## 检查节奏

处理其他批次的 session 路过时顺手跑一下 `spec-derived-unions.test.ts` 即可,无需专门盯守。
